# nd_change_control (Resource)

Manages change control system settings for Nexus Dashboard.

Change Control is a built-in Nexus Dashboard setting rather than a new object.
During Terraform creation, import the existing Change Control object first,
to see differences before applying changes.

During destroy, Terraform uses PUT to restore the default Change Control settings
before removing the resource from state. The built-in object remains in Nexus Dashboard.

If you want to stop managing Change Control without resetting its current Nexus Dashboard
settings, remove the resource from Terraform state with `terraform state rm
nd_change_control.<name>` and remove the resource block from the configuration. This
bypasses the provider destroy operation and leaves the Nexus Dashboard settings unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_change_control" "test_resource_change_control_1" {
  admin_status                    = true
  orchestration                   = true
  number_of_approvers             = 3
  allow_self_approval             = true
  nd_managed_fabrics              = true
  bypass_telemetry_change_control = true
  ticket_name_prefix              = "TICKET_"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_status` (Boolean) The admin status of the change control. The API requires at least one of `orchestration` or `nd_managed_fabrics` to be `true` when this is enabled. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `allow_self_approval` (Boolean) The self approval status of the change control for an orchestration action to approve that ticket. Defaults to `true` when not specified in the configuration.
- `bypass_telemetry_change_control` (Boolean) Bypasses change control for telemetry operations in Nexus Dashboard managed fabrics. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `nd_managed_fabrics` (Boolean) The Nexus Dashboard managed fabrics status of the change control. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `number_of_approvers` (Number) The number of approvals required for orchestration templates. This applies when `orchestration` is enabled and must be between `1` and `10`. Defaults to `1` when not specified in the configuration.
- `orchestration` (Boolean) The orchestration status of the change control for ACI fabrics. Defaults to `false` when not specified in the configuration.
- `ticket_name_prefix` (String) The prefix of the ticket name for the change control. The ticket name must start with a letter followed by one or more letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Defaults to `TICKET_` when not specified in the configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The fixed Terraform identifier for the Change Control settings is changeControl.
